<strong>Integrità di file e dati</strong: File and data integrity → SHA-256, SHA-512 or SHA-3
<strong>Token API e cookie firmati</stro: API tokens and signed cookies → HMAC-SHA256 or Ed25519
<strong>Dati in transito</strong> → TLS: Data in transit → TLS 1.3 (or well-configured 1.2) with a valid certificate
<strong>File e record cifrati</strong> →: Encrypted files and records → AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 (whole disks: AES-XTS)
<strong>Scambio di chiavi</strong> → X25: Key exchange → X25519 / ECDHE + HKDF; hybrid X25519MLKEM768 where available
<strong>Firme digitali</strong> → Ed2551: Digital signatures → Ed25519, ECDSA P-256 or RSA ≥ 3072 bits (PSS); plan the move to ML-DSA
<strong>MD5 / SHA-1</strong> per passwor: MD5 / SHA-1 for passwords, signatures or critical integrity
<strong>AES-CBC</strong> senza MAC (padd: AES-CBC without a MAC (padding oracle), AES in ECB mode
<strong>SSL, TLS 1.0 e 1.1</strong> e ci: SSL, TLS 1.0 and 1.1 and obsolete cipher suites
